description: One stack's story, oldest first (holding_id from search_collection or where_is): when its copies came in, where they moved, which decks claimed or released them, sleeves, proxy and foil changes, and where they went — following the copies across partial sleeves, splits and merges into the stacks they came from. A stack since removed or traded is still read by its id. Each entry names who made it (`by`: the web app, an assistant by its name, an API key, a partner app, an import or a swap) and whether it was undone. `since` is set when the stack is older than the history: say "in your collection since <date>, in <place>". Free reads the last 90 days: relay `plan_limit` when present. Changes nothing.
name: card_history

by.description: Who made the change: say so when it was not you

kind.description: web: the player in the web app; assistant, api_key, partner: by `name`; import; swap

name.description: The assistant's, key's or partner's name as it was then

holding_id.description: The stack it happened to: this one, or one its copies came from

op_id.description: The change it was part of: recent_activity op_id opens it

undone.description: An undo put this change back

in_collection.description: The stack is still in the collection; false when it was removed or traded away

older_hidden.description: Entries older than the plan shows, kept and shown on Plus

plan_limit.description: Relay this when present: what the plan does not show, and Plus shows

anyOf.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

since.description: The stack is older than its history: say "in your collection since <date>, in <place>"

title: Read a card's history
